$description: Verifiable questions for the agent eval: a model gets only the MCP tools and must answer correctly. Each answer is checked mechanically (exact, includes, regex or oneOf, case-insensitive). Run with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: npm run eval:agent

questions.question: What is the hex value of Haferglück's primary button colour?
Which CSS custom property should a Kiesel button use for its background?
Does Sonnfeld address customers with “du” or “Sie”? Answer with one word.
Haferglück wants the headline „Die neue Hafermilch“. What word must replace “Hafermilch”?
What exact sentence must every Kiesel disinfectant ad contain?
How much clear space does the Haferglück logo need, as a fraction of the logo height?
What is the minimum width in pixels of the Kiesel full logo in a display ad?
Which of these slots does Sonnfeld not book: medium-rectangle, mobile-banner, billboard? Answer with the slot id.
What are the pixel dimensions of a Haferglück leaderboard ad? Answer as WIDTHxHEIGHT.
May a Haferglück designer set white text on the sun-yellow surface? Answer yes or no.
What is the WCAG contrast ratio of Sonnfeld's accent.secondary on surface.brand, rounded to one decimal?
How many exclamation marks may a Kiesel text contain? Answer with a number.
Which Sonnfeld logo version goes on the navy brand surface? Answer with the version id.
A designer used #1E4C39 in Haferglück code. Which semantic token should the button background use instead? Answer with the token path.
Is the Sonnfeld headline „Ihr Sunblocker für den ganzen Tag“ allowed? Answer yes or no.
